caption: The drawing displays three views of a single brooch or pin in the shape of an eagle with outstretched wings and two stars, one beneath each wing. The top view shows the front of the object, revealing detailed feather patterns and shading in brown, reddish-brown, and yellow tones, with the eagle’s head facing left and the two five-pointed stars positioned under the talons. The middle view shows the pin from the top, highlighting the curvature of the wings and a gold or brass-colored pin mechanism that runs horizontally across the back. The bottom view is from the rear, showing the back side of the eagle and stars, as well as the full fastening mechanism, with the pin fixed in place on the left side. The drawing is set against a plain, off-white background with "John. H. Tercuzzi." written in small letters at the lower left corner.
title: Brooch
